# Method GetDraftingFormatMargins

#### GetDraftingFormatMargins(DocumentId, out Real, out Real, out Real, out Real, out Real, out Real)

Gets drafting document format margins

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 255, 0)]
void GetDraftingFormatMargins(DocumentId inDocumentId, out Real outbottomBorderMargin, out Real outTopBorderMargin, out Real outLeftBorderMargin, out Real outRightBorderMargin, out Real outLeftInternalMargin, out Real outRightInternalMargin)
```

|  Real |  outbottomBorderMargin |  bottom border margin  |
